arxiv-2105-06468.title: Dynamic View Synthesis from Dynamic Monocular Video
arxiv-2105-06468.creator: Chen Gao, Ayush Saraf, Johannes Kopf, Jia-Bin Huang
arxiv-2105-06468.description: Abstract We present an algorithm for generating novel views at arbitrary viewpoints and any input time step given a monocular video of a dynamic scene. Our work builds upon recent advances in neural implicit representation and uses continuous and differentiable functions for modeling the time-varying structure and the appearance of the scene.

arxiv-2311-07857.title: Detecting Dark Matter Induced Power in Quantum Devices
arxiv-2311-07857.creator: Rebecca K. Leane
arxiv-2311-07857.description: Abstract In the past few years, many mesoscale systems have been proposed as possible detectors of sub-GeV dark matter particles. In this work, we point out the feasibility of probing dark matter-nucleon scattering cross section using superconductor-based quantum devices with meV-scale energy threshold.

arxiv-2311-13593.title: Partial Resolutions of Affine Symplectic Singularities
arxiv-2311-13593.creator: Alberto San Miguel Malaney
arxiv-2311-13593.description: Abstract . We explore the relationship between the Poisson deformation theory, birational geometry, and Springer theory of partial resolutions of affine symplectic singularities. Let ρ : X ′ → X \rho:X^{\prime}\rightarrow X be a crepant partial resolution of a conical affine symplectic singularity X X .

arxiv-2401-00632.title: TbDd : A New Trust-based, DRL-driven Framework for Blockchain Sharding in IoT Thanks: Z. Zhang, X. Wang, and R. Liu are with the Global Big Data Technologies Centre, University of Technology Sydney, Australia, 2007 (e-mail: zixu.zhang@student.uts.edu.au; {xu.wang-1, renping.liu}@uts.edu.au) Thanks:
arxiv-2401-00632.creator: Zixu Zhang, Guangsheng Yu, Caijun Sun*, Xu Wang, Ying Wang, Ming Zhang, Wei Ni, Ren Ping Liu
arxiv-2401-00632.description: Abstract Integrating sharded blockchain with IoT presents a solution for trust issues and optimized data flow. Sharding boosts blockchain scalability by dividing its nodes into parallel shards, yet it’s vulnerable to the 1 % 1\% attacks where dishonest nodes target a shard to corrupt the entire blockchain. Balancing security with scalability is pivotal for such systems.

arxiv-2402-10173.title: Universal Quantum Computing with Field-Mediated Unruh–DeWitt Qubits
arxiv-2402-10173.creator: Eric W. Aspling, Michael J. Lawler
arxiv-2402-10173.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eric W. Aspling, Michael J. Lawler. A set of universal quantum gates is a vital part of the theory of quantum computing, but is absent in the developing theory of Relativistic Quantum Information (RQI). Yet, the Unruh–DeWitt (UDW) detector formalism can be elevated to unitary gates between qubits and quantum fields and has allowed RQI applications in quantum Shannon theory, such as mutual information, coherent information, and quantum capacity in field-mediated quantum channels.

arxiv-2408-03625.title: Background dependent cutoff for Wilson actions
arxiv-2408-03625.creator: Carlo Pagani, Hidenori Sonoda
arxiv-2408-03625.description: Abstract We study the application of the background field method in the framework of the exact renormalization group (ERG). By considering the case of a scalar field theory, we provide a detailed discussion of the properties satisfied by a background dependent Wilson action.

arxiv-2503-22363.title: ForcePose: A Deep Learning Approach for Force Calculation Based on Action Recognition Using MediaPipe Pose Estimation Combined with Object Detection
arxiv-2503-22363.creator: Nandakishor M, Vrinda Govind V, Anuradha Puthalath, Anzy L, Swathi P S
arxiv-2503-22363.description: Abstract Force estimation in human-object interactions plays a critical role in ergonomics, physical therapy, and sports science. Traditional methods rely on specialized equipment like force plates and sensors, making accurate assessments expensive and limited to laboratory environments. We present ForcePose, a novel deep learning framework that estimates applied forces by combining human pose estimation with object detection.

arxiv-2509-18067.title: Learning to Rank with Top- K K Fairness
arxiv-2509-18067.creator: Boyang Zhang bzhan29@lsu.edu, Quanqi Hu quanqi-hu@tamu.edu, Mingxuan Sun msun11@lsu.edu, Qihang Lin qihang-lin@uiowa.edu, Tianbao Yang tianbao-yang@tamu.edu
arxiv-2509-18067.description: Abstract Fairness in ranking models is crucial, as disparities in exposure can disproportionately affect protected groups. Most fairness-aware ranking systems focus on ensuring comparable average exposure for groups across the entire ranked list, which may not fully address real-world concerns.

arxiv-2510-21960.title: Under Pressure: Decoding the Effect of High Densities on Derived Nebular Properties
arxiv-2510-21960.creator: Zorayda Martinez, Danielle A. Berg, Bethan L. James, Karla Z. Arellano-Córdova, Daniel P. Stark, Peter Senchyna, Evan D. Skillman, Noah S. J. Rogers, John Chisholm
arxiv-2510-21960.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zorayda Martinez, Danielle A. Berg, Bethan L. James, Karla Z. Arellano-Córdova, Daniel P. Stark, Peter Senchyna, Evan D. Skillman, Noah S. J. Rogers, John Chisholm. Recent JWST observations have uncovered a population of compact, high-redshift ( z > 6 z>6 ) galaxies exhibiting extreme nebular conditions and enhanced nitrogen abundances that challenge standard chemical evolution paradigms.

arxiv-2512-07074.title: Machine Learning-based Unfolding for Cross Section Measurements in the Presence of Nuisance Parameters
arxiv-2512-07074.creator: Huanbiao Zhu, Krish Desai, Mikael Kuusela, Vinicius Mikuni, Benjamin Nachman, Larry Wasserman
arxiv-2512-07074.description: Abstract Statistically correcting measured cross sections for detector effects is an important step across many applications. In particle physics, this inverse problem is known as unfolding . In cases with complex instruments, the distortions they introduce are often known only implicitly through simulations of the detector. Modern machine learning has enabled efficient simulation-based approaches for unfolding high-dimensional data.

arxiv-2602-12667.title: Efficient Streaming Algorithms for Two-Dimensional Congruence Testing and Geometric Hashing
arxiv-2602-12667.creator: Yen-Cheng Chang, Tsun-Ming Cheung, Meng-Tsung Tsai, Ting-An Wu
arxiv-2602-12667.description: Abstract The geometric congruence problem is a fundamental building block in many computer vision and image recognition tasks. This problem considers the decision task of whether two point sets are congruent under translation and rotation. A related and more general problem, geometric hashing , considers the task of compactly encoding multiple point sets for efficient congruence queries.

arxiv-2605-02683.title: Exotic magnetism and persistent short-range spin correlations in a frustrated honeycomb antiferromagnet
arxiv-2605-02683.creator: M. Barik, Q. Faure, F. Damay, J. P. Embs, S. Petit, P. Khuntia

britannica-1911-baltimore-george-calvert.title: Baltimore, George Calvert, 1st Baron (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)

pmc-10551908.title: Technical and Economic Comparison between Sodium and Ammonium Agents in the Jarosite Precipitation Process—An Evaluation for Industrial Applications
pmc-10551908.creator: Ali Asimi Neisiani, Farhad Moosakazemi, Saeed Chehreh Chelgani
pmc-10551908.description: Iron content can cause severe challenges through zinc production from zinc sulfide concentrate. The zinc industry extensively uses the jarosite precipitation process (JPP) to precipitate dissolved iron and remove it before transferring the solution to downstream stages. Precipitating agents (PAs) play an essential role in the JPP.

pmc-10607678.title: Dissecting the Impact of Vascular Smooth Muscle Cell ABCA1 versus ABCG1 Expression on Cholesterol Efflux and Macrophage-like Cell Transdifferentiation: The Role of SR-BI
pmc-10607678.creator: Olanrewaju Oladosu, Ikechukwu C Esobi, Rhonda R Powell, Terri Bruce, Alexis Stamatikos, Deborah Henderson
pmc-10607678.description: Cholesterol-laden macrophages are recognized as a major contributor to atherosclerosis. However, recent evidence indicates that vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMC) that accumulate cholesterol and transdifferentiate into a macrophage-like cell (MLC) phenotype also play a role in atherosclerosis. Therefore, removing cholesterol from MLC may be a potential atheroprotective strategy.

pmc-10753412.title: LncRNAs exert indispensable roles in orchestrating the interaction among diverse noncoding RNAs and enrich the regulatory network of plant growth and its adaptive environmental stress response
pmc-10753412.creator: Lingling Zhang, Tao Lin, Guoning Zhu, Bin Wu, Chunjiao Zhang, Hongliang Zhu
pmc-10753412.description: With the advent of advanced sequencing technologies, non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) are increasingly pivotal and play highly regulated roles in the modulation of diverse aspects of plant growth and stress response. This includes a spectrum of ncRNA classes, ranging from small RNAs to long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs).

pmc-11354926.title: A New Look at Immunogenetics of Pregnancy: Maternal Major Histocompatibility Complex Class I Educates Uterine Natural Killer Cells
pmc-11354926.creator: Manon Bos, Francesco Colucci
pmc-11354926.description: Our incomplete knowledge of maternal–fetal interface (MFI) physiology impedes a better understanding of the pathological mechanisms leading to pregnancy complications, such as pre-eclampsia and fetal growth restriction. At the MFI, uterine natural killer (uNK) cells do not attack fetal cells but engage in crosstalk with both fetal and maternal cells to support feto-placental development.

pmc-11358269.title: Tetramethylpyrazine ameliorates LPS-induced acute lung injury via the miR-369-3p/DSTN axis
pmc-11358269.creator: Weiting Tao, Simin Min, Guofeng Chen, Xu He, Yuhang Meng, Li Li, Jie Chen, Yan Li
pmc-11358269.description: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a severe clinical respiratory condition characterized by high rates of mortality and morbidity, for which effective treatments are currently lacking. In this study, lipopolysaccharide (LPS) was used to induce ALI mice, demonstrating the efficacy of tetramethylpyrazine (TMP) in ameliorating ALI. Subsequent we perfored high-throughput sequencing analysis and used Targetscan 8.0 and miRWalk 3.

pmc-11511538.title: Description and Outcomes of an Ultrasound-Guided Technique for Catheter Placement in the Canine Quadratus Lumborum Plane: A Cadaveric Tomographic Study and Clinical Case Series
pmc-11511538.creator: Massimiliano Degani, Géraldine Bolen, Chiara Talarico, Stéphanie Noël, Kris Gommeren, Chiara Di Franco, Charlotte Sandersen, Susana Canfrán
pmc-11511538.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryIn human medicine, catheter implantation for local anesthetic administration in the quadratus lumborum (QL) inter-fascial plane (IFP) has been reported to extend the duration of a single-shot block’s effect in the postoperative period of patients undergoing abdominal surgeries.

pmc-11673988.title: Chemoenzymatic synthesis with the Pasteurella hyaluronan synthase; production of a multitude of defined authentic, derivatized, and analog polymers
pmc-11673988.creator: Paul L. DeAngelis
pmc-11673988.description: Hyaluronan (HA; [-3-GlcNAc-1-beta-4-GlcA-1-beta]n), an essential matrix polysaccharide of vertebrates and the molecular camouflage coating in certain pathogens, is polymerized by “HA synthase” (HAS) enzymes. Three HAS classes have been identified with biotechnological utility, but only the Class II PmHAS from Pasteurella multocida Type A has been useful for preparation of very defined HA polymers in vitro.

pmc-11712296.title: Multi‐atlas fully automated segmentation of the locus coeruleus in in vivo neuromelanin‐sensitive MRI
pmc-11712296.creator: Robin de Flores, Thaïs Blanchard, Emilie Foyard, Mikaël Naveau, Nicolas Delcroix, Brigitte Landeau, Paul A. Yushkevich, Gael Chételat
pmc-11712296.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLocus coeruleus (LC) imaging using neuromelanin‐sensitive (NM) MRI sequences is a promising biomarker for detecting early Alzheimer’s Disease (AD). Although automatic approaches have been developed to estimate LC integrity by measuring its intensity, these techniques most often rely on a single template built in a standardized space and/or depend on a number of voxels to be accounted that is defined a priori. Thus, these algorithms make it impossible to perform direct volumetric analyses and do not properly account for inter‐individual anatomical variability.

pmc-12494906.title: Effects of blood flow restriction combined with electrical stimulation on muscle functions and performance in university football players with knee osteoarthritis
pmc-12494906.creator: Jinfeng Yang, Na Li, Sheng He, Xiao Peng, Jinqi Yang, Jianxin Chen, Yan Zheng, Yunyan Zou, Yuanpeng Liao
pmc-12494906.description: The purpose of this study was to investigate the effects of combining blood flow restriction training (BFRT) with electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) on muscle functions and sports performance in football players with knee osteoarthritis (KOA). This parallel randomized controlled trial was conducted on 64 football players diagnosed with KOA at Chengdu Sport University.

pmc-12543431.title: Functional Connectivity, Tissue Microstructure, and T2 at 11.1 Tesla Distinguishes Neuroadaptive Differences in Two Traumatic Brain Injury Models in Rats: A Translational Outcomes Project in NeuroTrauma (TOP-NT) UG3 Phase Study
pmc-12543431.creator: Rohan S. Kommireddy, Shray Mehra, Marjory Pompilus, Rawad Daniel Arja, Tian Zhu, Zhihui Yang, Yueqiang Fu, Jiepei Zhu, Firas Kobeissy, Kevin K.W. Wang, Marcelo Febo
pmc-12543431.description: Traumatic brain injuries (TBIs), particularly contusive types, are associated with disruptions in neuronal communication due to focal and diffuse axonal injury, as well as alterations in the neuronal chemical environment. These changes can negatively impact neuronal networks beyond the primary injury site.

pmc-12578550.title: Therapeutic potential of IκB kinase epsilon inhibition in preventing meniscal degeneration of early osteoarthritis
pmc-12578550.creator: Ryota Hirose, Yukio Akasaki, Masanari Kuwahara, Taisuke Uchida, Yuki Hyodo, Mamiko Sakai, Takumi Kita, Ichiro Kurakazu, Martin K. Lotz, Yasuharu Nakashima
pmc-12578550.description: AimsMeniscal degeneration may precede or indicate early-stage osteoarthritis (OA); however, the pathogenetic involvement of the NF-κB pathway and its upstream IκB kinase (IKK) is unclear. This study investigated the functional role of IKK in the pathogenesis of meniscal degeneration, and the efficacy of IKKε inhibition as a therapeutic approach.MethodsIKK expression in normal and OA human menisci was analyzed immunohistochemically.

pmc-12586490.title: Hybrid Wavelet–ML models for regional drought forecasting in Norway
pmc-12586490.creator: Türker Tuğrul, Sertaç Oruç, Jessica Louise Hall, Ali Ulvi Galip Şenocak, Mehmet Ali Hınıs
pmc-12586490.description: Drought is a natural disaster that often remains unnoticed until ecosystem impacts become severe. Therefore, monitoring and detecting droughts are important research topics. Consequently, drought indices with different focuses, such as precipitation or soil moisture, have been developed. Yet, the utility of the indices is limited before the beginning of the drought.

pmc-13198470.title: Fractionated testosterone gel replacement therapy in clinical practice: A real-world exploratory clinical experience
pmc-13198470.creator: Virginia Maltese, Andrea Delbarba, Elisa Gatta, Simone Vetrugno, Andrea Sansone, Carlo Cappelli
pmc-13198470.description: BackgroundTestosterone replacement therapy (TRT) with transdermal gel is widely used in men with hypogonadism. Guidelines recommend once-daily application with monitoring of serum testosterone at peak levels. However, real-world clinical experience suggests that peak–trough fluctuations in some patients, potentially affecting hormonal stability and treatment tolerability. The impact of dose fractionation remains unclear.

pmc-13346875.title: A concise and practical route to Gedatolisib via a continuous-flow Kumada coupling reaction
pmc-13346875.creator: Jianhai Yang, Jun Li, Donghe Tian, Cai Xu, Liyan Dai, Xiaozhong Wang, Jia Guo, Weibin Fan
pmc-13346875.description: A practical three-step route to Gedatolisib, a dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor for breast cancer, has been developed, featuring a key continuous-flow iron-catalyzed Kumada coupling. This continuous-flow setup enhances heat and mass transfer, eliminates the need for noble metal catalysts and associated removal steps. This approach avoids hazardous reagents as well as high-boiling solvents, thereby improving both safety and scalability.

pmc-13589524.title: Public Health Challenges in Somalia: Strengthening Health Systems for Resilient and Equitable Healthcare Delivery
pmc-13589524.creator: Jamal Hassan Mohamoud, Mohamed Hussein Adam, Ahmed Mahad Sheikh Mohamed
pmc-13589524.description: Somalia continues to face multidimensional public health challenges driven by prolonged conflict, political instability, fragmented governance, climate-related disasters, displacement, poverty, and a fragile health system. The country carries a dual burden of communicable and non-communicable diseases (NCDs), alongside persistently high maternal and child mortality and recurrent nutrition and WASH emergencies.
